Introduction To The Use Of Laboratory
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of a chamber with a regulated temperature."
An incubator is made up of a chamber with a regulated temperature.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very suitable device for taking weather at a very altitude and at a very low cost compared to aircrafts."
The weather balloon is a very suitable device for taking weather at a very altitude and at a very low cost compared to aircrafts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for isotope separation, such as to enrich nuclear fuel for fissile isotopes."
Gas centrifuges are used for isotope separation, such as to enrich nuclear fuel for fissile isotopes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to keep track of the contents of the diver's air tank."
A submersible pressure gauge is used to keep track of the contents of the diver's air tank.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool that hinges on the quantitative analysis of molecules depending on how much light is absorbed by colored compounds."
Spectrophotometry is a tool that hinges on the quantitative analysis of molecules depending on how much light is absorbed by colored compounds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to simulate high gravity or acceleration environments (for example, high-G training for test pilots)."
Large centrifuges are used to simulate high gravity or acceleration environments (for example, high-G training for test pilots).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are defined in the Globally Harmonized System and in the European Union chemical regulations."
Chemical Chemical hazards are defined in the Globally Harmonized System and in the European Union chemical regulations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method involving bonding two different gel molecules together to create a sol-gel as a whole."
Condensation is a method involving bonding two different gel molecules together to create a sol-gel as a whole.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in washing machines and at some swimming pools to wring water out of fabrics."
Medium-sized centrifuges are used in washing machines and at some swimming pools to wring water out of fabrics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered a hazard because it damages DNA and can cause human health issues like skin cancer and cataracts."
UV radiation is considered a hazard because it damages DNA and can cause human health issues like skin cancer and cataracts.

centrifuge

barometer
